input.instructions: Design a high-level skill experiment in local PyBullet xArm6. JSON only, Chinese prose. Goal: grasp, toss upward with measured free-flight rise >=0.05m from release, catch on descent, place gently on ground z=0. Reuse grasp_without_lift_v1. Ground scene, arm base z=0. No object position/velocity injection, launch force, gravity change, joint-limit change. Idealized fixed-constraint grasp/catch; robot-cube collision disabled, so results are simulation scoped. Predefined local primitive settles held cube near [0.40,0,0.22], sweeps toward target, releases at FIRST step when CURRENT vz >= release_min_vz_m_s, then follows horizontal flight with catch_lead_s. Catch requires real apex, rise>=0.05m, descending vz<-0.05m/s, wrist distance<=0.13m, cube at least 0.10m below wrist (finger workspace, needed for ground clearance), relative speed<=1m/s, >=10 unconstrained ticks, no flight contact. Then hold 0.5s, lower slowly to actual ground support, release at speed<=0.015m/s, observe 2s, drift<=0.003m, speed<=0.01m/s. Choose parameters exactly: target_x_m [0.25,0.55], target_z_m [0.40,0.85], release_min_vz_m_s [1.04,1.40], max_sweep_steps integer [20,180], catch_lead_s [0,0.12]. Return decision try/stop/accept, prerequisite_skill_ids ["grasp_without_lift_v1"], parameters, observed_facts array, hypotheses array, rationale string. First response must try. After a success propose the SAME parameters for independent validation. Accept only after three complete consecutive validation trials. Preserve the exact 0.05m target throughout. No code or low-level joint commands. Use actual measured reports to refine parameters.
